# Original OpenType shaping fixtures

GPL-3.0-only, copyright 2026 EXReader contributors. All glyph outlines are original
rectangles generated by `tools/generate_shaping_test_fonts.py`. The fixtures contain
no system font outlines. Regeneration uses fontTools 4.63.0; building and running
the C tests uses the committed TTF files and requires no Python package.

The font has 1000 units per em. `manifest.json` records the fixed glyph order,
nominal widths, compiled lookup kinds and SHA-256 values. C assertions use explicit
glyph IDs, UTF-8 cluster ranges, advances and offsets. All ordinary geometry cases
use 20 px, so one font unit equals 0.02 px.

| Feature | Independent case |
| --- | --- |
| `liga` | `ffi` → gid 6, width 750; `fi` → gid 7, width 450; marks are ignored while matching |
| `isol/init/medi/fina` | Arabic beh, lam and alef joining forms; transparent fatha and ZWJ/ZWNJ boundaries |
| `rlig` | lam-init + alef-final → lam-alef, gid 31; lam-medial + alef-final → gid 32 |
| `kern` | `A V`: first advance 600 − 100 = 500 |
| `mark` | base and ligature anchors, including a mark on the first versus last ligature component |
| `mkmk` | dot anchor `(20,10)` attaches to acute anchor `(100,200)` |
| `ss01` | multiple substitution `x` → `a b`, both outputs retain the source range |
| `ss02` | alternate substitution `y` → `[a b c]`, selected by a one-based feature value |
| `ss03` | single substitution `z` → `d` |
| `ss04/ss05` | contextual and chained contextual substitution |
| `ss06` | reverse chained single substitution |
| `ss07` | extension substitution |
| `ss08` | single positioning with all four value components `(20,30,40,50)` |
| `ss09` | class-pair positioning, advance adjustment −80 |
| `ss10` | chained contextual positioning |
| `ss11` | extension positioning |
| `ss12` | cursive entry/exit anchors on `x y` |
| `zz01/zz02/zz03` | explicit GSUB Context formats 1/2/3, matching `a b` and substituting `b` → `d` |
| `zz04/zz05` | explicit GSUB ChainContext formats 2/3, matching backtrack `a`, input `b`, lookahead `c` |
| `zz06/zz07/zz08` | explicit GPOS Context formats 1/2/3, positioning the `b` in `a b` |
| `zz09/zz10` | explicit GPOS ChainContext formats 2/3 with backtrack/input/lookahead |

Anchor calculations include the already advanced logical pen. For `a + acute`,
the base advance is 500, base anchor is `(300,700)` and mark anchor is `(0,0)`:
the mark offset is therefore `(-200,700)`. A following dot has offset `(-120,890)`.
For `fi + acute`, the final-component anchor gives `(-70,650)`; for `f + acute + i`,
the first-component anchor gives `(-350,650)`. These two inputs exercise retained
ligature component provenance rather than always attaching to the last component.

Values were independently checked with HarfBuzz 14.6.0 through the development-only
uharfbuzz 0.56.3 package. HarfBuzz uses visual glyph order for RTL runs; EXReader's
test contract uses logical glyph order and logical-pen offsets. Thus `beh + fatha + beh`
returns init/fatha/final, and the fatha offset is `(-300,600)` with cluster
range `[0,4)`. The corresponding HarfBuzz visual-order mark offset is `(300,600)`.
The `ss08` test keeps the raw yAdvance of 50 font units, as required by the public
coordinate API; horizontal HarfBuzz output suppresses that component.

`line-boundary.ttf` is generated from the same original outlines and glyph order.
Its default `kern` pair gives `A` an advance adjustment of -100 units and `V`
placement `(120,80)` plus advance adjustment -50. At 20 px, an unbroken `AV`
therefore advances `(10,11)` px and places `V` at offset `(2.4,1.6)` px; isolated
`A` and `V` each advance 12 px with zero offset. A default `curs` feature connects
`x/y` and Arabic beh forms, so layout tests verify that both outgoing and incoming
pair/cursive adjustments and Arabic joining stop at actual line boundaries.
The original `shaping.ttf` and damaged-table variants are unchanged.

`broken-gsub.ttf` and `broken-gpos.ttf` change only the selected table header's
LookupListOffset to `0xFFFF`, beyond that table's length. Their outline/cmap data
remain usable by FreeType; shaping must reject the invalid OpenType offset with
`EXR_FONT` and clear both output pointer and count.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```sh
python tools/generate_shaping_test_fonts.py
```
